children.label: Validate required manifest permissions and the sidebar panel entry point

[]; if(changes.length!==1 || changes[0].path!==node.evidence.value) throw new Error(`bad file change ${node.id}`); } leaves += 1; } } trace.tree.forEach(walk); console.log(`ATML shape: valid (${ids.size} nodes, ${leaves} leaves)`);'
